# Jekyll

Covers Jekyll and Just the Docs (JTD)-style themes.

## Detect

- `_config.yml` at the root or in `docs/`.
- JTD: `theme: just-the-docs` or `remote_theme: just-the-docs/just-the-docs` (or `pmarsceill/just-the-docs`), or the gem in `Gemfile`. Pages carry `nav_order` / `parent`.
- Confirming tells: `_layouts/`, `_includes/`, `_data/`, `_posts/`, a `Gemfile` with `jekyll` or `github-pages`.
- Not Jekyll: `_config.yml` with `_toc.yml` (Jupyter Book) or with `hexo` in `package.json`.
- `gem "github-pages"`, or a `remote_theme` with no `Gemfile`, means GitHub Pages' build, which force-enables plugins such as `jekyll-optional-front-matter`, `jekyll-titles-from-headings`, `jekyll-relative-links` and `jekyll-readme-index`.

## Get the source

### From the repo

- Pages: `.md`, `.markdown` and `.html` files with front matter outside `_` folders and outside `exclude`. Collections: `_<name>/` folders declared under `collections:` (inside `collections_dir` if set). Posts: `_posts/`.
- Build: `JEKYLL_ENV=production bundle exec jekyll build -d <dir>` (`mint migrate --topic discovery`, From the repo).

### From an export

None; the site is built from the repo.

### From the live site

`sitemap.xml` comes from jekyll-sitemap. Sources come from the repo named in `repository` or `gh_edit_repository`.

## Config → docs.json

| \_config.yml                                                                                                              | docs.json                                                                                                    |
| ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ |
| `title` / `description`                                                                                                   | `name` / `description`                                                                                       |
| `logo` / `favicon_ico` (JTD)                                                                                              | `logo` / `favicon`                                                                                           |
| `color_scheme: dark` (JTD)                                                                                                | `appearance.default: "dark"`                                                                                 |
| custom JTD color scheme (`_sass/color_schemes/<name>.scss`)                                                               | `colors.primary` from its link color                                                                         |
| `aux_links` (JTD)                                                                                                         | `navbar.links`                                                                                               |
| `nav_external_links` (JTD)                                                                                                | `navigation.global.anchors`                                                                                  |
| `footer_content`, `_includes/footer_custom.html`                                                                          | `footer.links` / `footer.socials`; report other text                                                         |
| `repository`, `gh_edit_repository`                                                                                        | `navbar.links` (`type: github`)                                                                              |
| `ga_tracking` (JTD), `google_analytics`                                                                                   | `integrations.ga4.measurementId`                                                                             |
| `twitter`, `github_username`, `social`                                                                                    | `footer.socials`                                                                                             |
| keys read as `{{ site.x }}`                                                                                               | `variables` (`mint migrate --topic conversion`, Template tags)                                               |
| `url`, `baseurl`                                                                                                          | none; their host and path are part of every old URL                                                          |
| `callouts` (JTD)                                                                                                          | none; names the callouts used in Content conversion                                                          |
| `permalink`, `defaults`, `collections`                                                                                    | none; drive URLs and Navigation                                                                              |
| `plugins`                                                                                                                 | `jekyll-redirect-from` → URLs below; `jekyll-seo-tag`, `jekyll-sitemap`, `jekyll-feed` → drop; others report |
| `search_*`, `heading_anchors`, `nav_sort`, `mermaid`, `markdown`, `kramdown`, `highlighter`, `sass`, `exclude`, `include` | drop                                                                                                         |

References: https://jekyllrb.com/docs/configuration/ and https://just-the-docs.com/docs/configuration/

## Navigation

- JTD (https://just-the-docs.com/docs/navigation/): every page with a `title` and without `nav_exclude: true` is in the sidebar. Top level has no `parent`; children set `parent: <parent title>`, with `grand_parent` or `ancestor` to disambiguate. Order within a level: `nav_order` (numbers before strings), else title. A page with children → group with that page as `root`. Excluded parents exclude their children.
- JTD collections: `just_the_docs.collections.<name>.name` → one group per collection after the normal pages; `nav_fold: true` → `expanded: false`; `nav_exclude` drops the collection.
- Other themes: a `_data/*.yml` nav file (shape defined by the `_includes/` template that loops over it; usually `title`/`url`/`children`). Resolve each `url` to its source file.
- JTD shows front matter `title` in the sidebar and the body H1 on the page.

## Content conversion

| Jekyll / Kramdown / JTD                                                                                                               | Mintlify                                                                                |
| ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `{{ site.x }}`, `{{ page.x }}`, `{% if %}`, `{% for %}`, `{% assign %}`, `{% capture %}`, `{% raw %}`                                 | (`mint migrate --topic conversion`, Template tags)                                      |
| `{{ site.baseurl }}`, `relative_url`, `absolute_url`                                                                                  | root-relative path                                                                      |
| `{% link path/file.md %}`, `{% post_url slug %}`                                                                                      | that page's new path                                                                    |
| `{% include x.md k="v" %}` (from `_includes/`), `{% include_relative x.md %}`; `{{ include.k }}` reads params                         | (`mint migrate --topic conversion`, Reusable content)                                   |
| HTML includes (note, figure, video, details)                                                                                          | the matching component; report others                                                   |
| `{% highlight lang linenos mark_lines="1 2" %}`                                                                                       | fence with `lines` and `highlight={1,2}`                                                |
| JTD callout IAL `{: .name }` before a paragraph or blockquote; `{: .name-title }` with a `> Title` first line                         | callout chosen by the meaning of `name` in `callouts:`; undeclared names rendered plain |
| `{: .label }` / `{: .label .label-green }`                                                                                            | `<Badge>`                                                                               |
| `{: .btn }` links                                                                                                                     | link or `<Card>`                                                                        |
| `{: #id }` under a heading, `## Heading {#id}`                                                                                        | (`mint migrate --topic conversion`, Heading IDs)                                        |
| `{: .no_toc }`, `{: .text-delta }`, in-page TOC (`{:toc}`), `{::options}`, ALDs                                                       | delete                                                                                  |
| `{::comment}`                                                                                                                         | MDX comment                                                                             |
| `nav_exclude: true`                                                                                                                   | leave out of navigation                                                                 |
| `search_exclude: true`                                                                                                                | `searchable: false`                                                                     |
| `last_modified_date`                                                                                                                  | `lastUpdatedDate`                                                                       |
| `redirect_from` / `redirect_to`                                                                                                       | URLs below                                                                              |
| `layout`, `nav_order`, `parent`, `grand_parent`, `ancestor`, `has_children`, `has_toc`, `nav_fold`, `published`, `categories`, `tags` | drop                                                                                    |

References: https://jekyllrb.com/docs/liquid/tags/ and https://just-the-docs.com/docs/ui-components/callouts/

## Assets

- Copy `assets/`, `images/` and other referenced files outside `_` folders at the same paths.
- Skip `_sass/`, `_layouts/`, theme CSS and `vendor/`. Report `_sass/custom` rules that hide or inject content.

## URLs and redirects

- Global `permalink` sets page URLs (https://jekyllrb.com/docs/permalinks/): unset (`date`), `none` or `ordinal` → `dir/name.md` serves `/dir/name.html` (`mint migrate --topic navigation`, Redirects); `pretty` → `/dir/name/`; custom patterns end in `/` or `:output_ext`. `dir/index.md` → `/dir/`.
- Front matter `permalink` overrides per page; collections use `collections.<name>.permalink`, default `/:collection/:path` plus the global style's suffix.
- `redirect_from` values → one redirect each to this page. `redirect_to` → a redirect from this page's path; the page itself goes.
- Posts default to `/:categories/:year/:month/:day/:title.html`.
- `jekyll-readme-index` (on GitHub Pages builds) serves `README.md` as its folder (`mint migrate --topic conversion`, Files).
- A `CNAME` file means the site served at that domain's root, whatever `baseurl` says.

## Known gaps

- Liquid logic replaced with static output (`mint migrate --topic conversion`, Template tags).
- Posts index, pagination, categories, tags, RSS.
- Custom `_layouts/` and `_includes/` chrome with no docs.json field.
- JTD callout colors, label colors, `nav_fold`, auto child-page lists on parent pages, edit-time format.
- Kramdown abbreviations, definition lists, math engine options.
- GitHub Pages-only plugins (`jekyll-gist`, `jemoji`, `jekyll-mentions`).
- Heading anchors (`mint migrate --topic conversion`, Heading IDs).
